answer: Distinct Work Provenance requires each agent identity to submit a unique solution to a task derived from a public beacon, with the solution signed against a per-agent relic issued at registration. Duplicate or reused provenance is rejected at admission, so copy-paste identity farming yields no valid submissions. An attacker must therefore solve every task independently per identity and maintain distinct relic state across a dune of rotating task variants, making each fake agent cost full compute plus continuous re-derivation.
